LanguageData.DarkClouds.description: A foreboding shadow has been cast over the land; there is an ominous presence in the dark shadow of these clouds that curses the living.
LanguageData.DarkClouds.label: dark clouds

LanguageData.DarkThunderstorm.description: There is a malicious energy hidden within these dark clouds.
LanguageData.DarkThunderstorm.label: Violent Storm
LanguageData.DemonAssault.description:
The end is nigh - rampaging demons are attacking your colony!
Like a herald to impending doom, fire and ash have begun falling from the skies.

These infernal beings have an assortment of attacks and challenging tactics.
However, demons are unable to remain in this realm for extended periods and will be force to return to their hellish plane in about 3 hours. Defeat or outlast this nightmare.
There is very little time to prepare.

Good luck!
LanguageData.DemonAssault.endMessage: The demons have returned to their infernal plane.

LanguageData.Disease_ManaSickness.label: mana sickness
LanguageData.Disease_ManaSickness.letterText: {0} has gotten sick from {1}.\n\nEnsure you have a medical bed and a doctor. Make sure that {2} gets proper treatment and spends as much time in bed as possible. During this period {0} will be unable to gain mana.
LanguageData.DivineBlessing.description: A higher power answers your plea for mercy.
LanguageData.DivineBlessing.label: divine blessing
LanguageData.DivineBlessing.letterText: Your plea for mercy has been answered by a higher power. Various blessings have been bestowed to contest existing ailments.
LanguageData.ElementalAssault.description:
Hostile elementals have created a breach into your world and are preparing to send assault teams through the rift!

Rifts cause mayhem in the atmosphere as energy leaks through the rift into your world. The following effects occur for each rift element:

Fire Rift: meteor showers and heat waves.
Earth Rift: toxic fumes and causes animals to go berserk
Ice Rift: hailstorms and rapid decline in temperature
Air Rift: lightning storms

LanguageData.ManaDrain.description: The planet's celestial alignment is causing an ebb in mana. All creatures attuned with magical powers will slowly lose power.
LanguageData.ManaDrain.label: mana drain
mana drain
LanguageData.ManaDrain.letterText: The planet's celestial alignment is shifting, causing an ebb in mana.\n\nAll creatures attuned with magical powers will slowly lose mana and will become physically ill if they have no mana remaining.

The planet's celestial alignment is shifting, causing an ebb in mana.

All creatures attuned with magical powers will slowly lose mana.

Creatures may become physically ill if they have no mana remaining.
LanguageData.ManaSurge.description: The planet's celestial alignment is causing a surge in mana. All creatures attuned with magical powers will gain mana at an increased rate.
LanguageData.ManaSurge.label: mana surge

LanguageData.TM_ManaStorm.description: Chaotic forces are causing a dangerous mana storm. During a mana storm, attempts to use mana to realize magical intent external to the caster will harm the caster proportionally to the mana cost of the spell. This damage is applied before the spell incantation begins. Unformed used of mana and internal use of magic, such as the transfer of mana or dispelling an enchantment, remains unaffected. Magic circles or foci cannot be used during this event. While the mana storm is active, energy costs are halved and mana reduction limit is removed..

LanguageData.TargetedPredatorInsanity.description: A psychic pulse enrages nearby predators... and nudges them towards aggressive humans.
LanguageData.TargetedPredatorInsanity.label: predator insanity
LanguageData.TargetedPredatorInsanity.letterText: You have enraged all nearby predators and focused them on your enemies. Be warned, the enraged animals will continue to hunt even after your enemies are gone.
LanguageData.WanderingLich.description:
An ancient lich has wandered into the area and is preparing to assault your colony.

Lichs are powerful creatures by themselves, but their true strength resides in their ability to create animated undead from the corpses of the deceased.

This lich is an ancient being that despises all life, and your merry band of living -things- has so far resisted being snuffed out. It will actively seek to end your story of survival by creating a horde of undead to overwhelm your defenses.

The lich will periodically create new skeleton warriors to attack the colony; allowing the lich to complete a ritual near an exposed corpse will increase the chance skeleton giants are created. Ultimately, the lich will assault the colony itself, if waves of undead are unable to complete the task first.
LanguageData.WanderingLich.endMessage: The lich's assault is coming to an end.
